in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who resides in the abode of Rama, a name of Lord Vishnu. Rama is a popular name for a deity and an epithet of Lord Rama, an avatar of Vishnu, who is known for his virtues, courage and righteousness.

in_hindi.name: हर्मेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who resides in the abode of Shiva, a name of Lord Shiva. Shiva is one of the three major gods in Hinduism, and is the god of destruction, time, and regeneration. He is known as the Supreme God and the God of Gods.

in_marathi.name: Harmesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harmesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Harmesh is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a compound of two words: Haram (God's) andesh (treasure). vedic_reference.note: The name Harmesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Rama' and 'Ish' (meaning 'God'). It is a name of Lord Rama in Hinduism, who is an avatar of Vishnu and is known for his virtues, courage, and righteousness. In Hindu mythology, Rama is considered to be the ideal man and the embodiment of dharma. The name Harmesh can also be considered a name of Lord Shiva, as 'Ish' is also a common epithet of Shiva.
